policies.sentence: Students are expected to use AI coding agents on projects, which are built around the agent writing the code.
Students must not use agentic coding tools, or should limit AI work to a chat interface.
Using agentic AI to complete assessments without human interaction is cheating.
Students with significant programming experience may use agentic coding on comprehensive projects.
Students are encouraged to use coding agents as learning tools.
Students may set an agent up on a long task and walk away.
Current coding agents can produce complete projects without human help.
